com.esignal.jstandard.beans.marketdepth

Interface MarketDepthRequest

  • All Superinterfaces:
    TurnAroundAware
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultMarketDepthRequest

    public interface MarketDepthRequest
extends TurnAroundAware
    The Purpose of this interface is to provide possible request options while making a request or subscription for all the different MarketDepth requests . In general, MarketDepthRequest makes it possible for clients to requests the data that the user is interested in by supplying as much input parameters as possible for the Market Depth Data.
    Since:
    01-08-000
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
    TurnAroundAware, MarketDepthManager
